title: From binding to networks: methods for identifying transcription factor targets in plant systems.
authors: Sumner, Adam T; Bargmann, Bastiaan O R; Haak, David C
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统比较了植物转录因子靶基因鉴定的实验与计算方法，涵盖ChIP-seq、DAP-seq及机器学习预测工具，虽聚焦植物TF-DNA互作但以方法综述为主，缺乏深度建模机制研究，对本课题有方法参考价值。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) orchestrate gene expression programs by binding regulatory DNA sequences and modulating transcription of target genes. Identifying TF-target gene relationships is fundamental to understanding plant development, stress responses, and metabolic regulation. However, determining which genes a TF regulates remains technically challenging. This review provides a decision-oriented framework, that integrates experimental and computational plant TF-target identification. Placing emphasis on plant-specific constraints and practical method selection to guide researchers from initial TF discovery through comprehensive network characterization. We compare biochemical approaches (EMSA, Y1H), genome-wide mapping methods (ChIP-seq, DAP-seq, CUT&Tag), expression profiling techniques (RNA-seq on mutants and overexpression lines), and computational prediction tools (GENIE3, PTFSpot, ConnecTF). Critical trade-offs are discussed, between binding potential and functional regulation, throughput and resolution, and between different model and non-model plant systems. Finally, we highlight emerging technologies including high-throughput enhancer screening, single-cell approaches, and machine learning-based prediction platforms that promise to accelerate functional characterization of plant TFs and their regulatory networks.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过结合调控性DNA序列并调节靶基因的转录来编排基因表达程序。识别转录因子-靶基因关系是理解植物发育、胁迫响应及代谢调控的基础。然而，确定一个转录因子调控哪些基因在技术上仍具挑战性。本综述提供了一个以决策为导向的框架，整合了实验性和计算性的植物转录因子-靶基因识别方法。重点强调植物特有的限制因素及实用方法选择，以引导研究者从最初的转录因子发现到全面的网络特征分析。我们比较了生化方法（EMSA、Y1H）、全基因组映射技术（ChIP-seq、DAP-seq、CUT&Tag）、表达谱分析技术（突变体和过表达系的RNA-seq）以及计算预测工具（GENIE3、PTFSpot、ConnecTF）。讨论了结合潜力与功能调控、通量与分辨率，以及不同模式与非模式植物系统之间的关键权衡。最后，我们强调了新兴技术，包括高通量增强子筛选、单细胞方法及基于机器学习的预测平台，这些技术有望加速植物转录因子及其调控网络的功能特征化。
